title.en: The self-built line is longer than Electric 15. Which page next?
title.zh: 自建管路长过电动15，下一页是哪一台？

description.en: Leave 60–80 m horizontal and 15–20 m vertical. A grid building line at 120 m / 40 m and 1–2 cm stone is Electric 20. No grid and a longer rural window is the 4100 or Diesel 30, depending on the cells.
description.zh: 离开水平 60–80 m 和垂直 15–20 m。有电网、120 m / 40 m、石子 1–2 cm 的建筑管路是电动20。无电网且农村窗口更长时，按格子看 4100 或柴油30。

h1.en: The self-built line is longer than Electric 15. Which page next?
h1.zh: 自建管路长过电动15，下一页是哪一台？

directAnswer.en: Do not stretch Electric 15. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai stops that rural row at 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal. On a grid, the next published building row with a single distance pair is Electric 20 at 120 m / 40 m, 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h and 1–2 cm stone. Without a grid, the 4100 prints 40–100 m / 15–45 m, and Diesel 30 prints 60 m / 180 m at 15 m³/h. Pick the page whose cells you can actually meet, including stone.
directAnswer.zh: 不要把电动15拉长。邢台河北品锦机械把那一行农村泵停在垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。有电网时，下一档只印一对距离的建筑行是电动20：120 m / 40 m、22 kW、8–10 m³/h、石子 1–2 cm。没有电网时，4100 印 40–100 m / 15–45 m，柴油30印 60 m / 180 m、15 m³/h。选你真正对得上的那一页，包括石子。

heading.en: Electric 20 changes more than the metres
heading.zh: 电动20改变的不只是米数

body.en: It also changes aggregate from 1–3 cm to 1–2 cm, adds 10 MPa, an 80 mm pipe, a 0.25 m³ hopper and 900 kg. A 3 cm stone that was allowed on Electric 15 is outside Electric 20. In that case the longer grid row may be Electric 30, which prints ≤ 3 cm and a short aggregate-13 distance of 20 m / 60 m beside a fine-stone 60 m / 180 m. Read the stone before celebrating the longer vertical.
body.zh: 它还把骨料从 1–3 cm 改成 1–2 cm，并加上 10 MPa、80 mm 管、0.25 m³ 料斗和 900 kg。电动15允许的 3 cm 石子不在电动20里。这时更长的电网行可能是电动30，它印了 ≤ 3 cm，以及细石 60 m / 180 m 旁边较短的 13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。在为更长的垂直高兴之前，先读石子。

heading.en: Off-grid longer does not mean Diesel 120
heading.zh: 无电网更长不等于柴油120

body.en: Diesel 30’s 60 m / 180 m or the 4100’s 40–100 m may already cover the line. Diesel 120’s 500 m vertical is a 100 m³/h, 8000 kg infrastructure machine. A house that missed Electric 15 by a few metres of pipe is not that machine.
body.zh: 柴油30的 60 m / 180 m 或 4100 的 40–100 m 可能已经盖住管路。柴油120的垂直 500 m 是 100 m³/h、8000 kg 的基建机器。管路只比电动15长出几米的住宅，不是那台机器。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send the metres that exceeded 60–80 m or 15–20 m, plus the stone. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发送超出 60–80 m 或 15–20 m 的那些米数，并附上石子。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does Electric 15 have a hidden longer rating?
question.zh: 电动15有没有隐藏的更长额定值？

answer.en: No. The published cells are the window.
answer.zh: 没有。已公布的格子就是窗口。

question.en: Is Electric 10 Series the step up?
question.zh: 电动10系列是向上一档吗？

answer.en: No. Its horizontal cell is 25 m, which is shorter.
answer.zh: 不是。它的水平格是 25 m，更短。

answer.en: You send the measurements. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai matches a listed page. The page does not invent a bridge model between Electric 15 and Electric 20.
answer.zh: 你发送测量值。邢台河北品锦机械对照已列页面。这一页不会在电动15和电动20之间编一台过渡型号。
